signup.heading: Forensic Infrastructure for
signup.manifestoBefore: Sustrato.ai has evolved. It's no longer a productivity tool, it's an
signup.manifestoMiddle: In an era of synthetic metrics, we claim
signup.manifestoAfter: the right to research with tools that amplify human intuition and leave an auditable trail, instead of replacing thought.
signup.betaDescriptionBefore: We're tidying up the garden. Direct access is restricted to guarantee the stability of the environment, but
signup.betaDescriptionAfter: to collaborate, audit or support. The door isn't closed, it just has a doorman.
